about_the_game:
Heal a wounded island and nurture it back to life — through cleanup, repair, habitat restoration, companionship, and quiet evenings by the fire.

Restore Your Island is a slow-paced, tactile restoration sim about healing places and building a home. Here, your primary work is ecological: surveying damaged areas, removing pollution and debris, repairing habitats, and guiding the island’s ecosystems back toward balance. Every cleared cove and tree healed produce visible, satisfying change — wildlife return, birds come back, and little communities of life reappear where once there was only silence.

You’ll move through the island at your own pace. Use a range of tools — including specialized fertilizer as one option — to assist in rehabilitation. Trees, once revived, become part of the living loop, occasionally providing fruit which helps you keep going. Your loyal dog is a constant companion — pet them, play mini-games, and watch your relationship grow. The fireplace is your emotional hub: sit, listen to calming music and the water’s sound, and watch your island change. We’re expanding fireplace features in later updates so it becomes a richer centerpiece of daily life.

Explore & Observe — walk the island, mark places needing attention, and plan how to restore them.

Clean & Repair — remove trash, mend structures, Heal trees — actions that let nature begin to recover.

Restore Habitats — rebuild dunes, fix ports, and use tools to rescue wildlife.

Support & Sustain — revived trees produce resources; fruits that help you sustain longer sessions and reach new areas.

Companion Play & Care — pet your dog and play short, rewarding mini-games that deepen the bond and occasionally unlock helpful cues or small rewards.

Relax & Reflect — return to your cabin and the fireplace: play music, enjoy water ambience, watch the sunset, and plan the next restoration project.

Grow & Explore — upgrade tools, unlock new zones, discover secrets — then repeat with a bigger, more vibrant island.

KEY FEATURES

  • Place-focused restoration: The joy is in the whole — healing beaches and woodlands so the island itself visibly changes.

  • Tangible visual progress: Every clean sweep, repaired habitat, and re-greening produces immediate, readable results.

  • Companion & small joys: A trusting dog who reacts to pets, plays, and helps you explore — the emotional center of the game.

  • Cozy hub: the fireplace: Sit by the fire, listen to calming songs and water; the fireplace is a restful place and a growing gameplay feature.

  • Creative personalization: Design and decorate your cabin, place small structures, and make the island feel like yours.

  • Accessible, low-pressure gameplay: No combat, no harsh timers — play in short bursts or long sessions with comfort options.

  • Discovery & secrets: Hidden groves, Buried treasures, and small environmental mysteries reward curiosity.

  • Mechanics that support the mood: Tools like fertilizer and fruit-driven energy exist to pace exploration — they help you keep doing what matters: restoring the place.|

WHY PLAY?

If you love games that reward observation and small, meaningful actions — turning damaged places into living, breathing spaces — this is for you. It’s not about power or speed; it’s about care, creative expression, and companionship: fixing what’s broken and enjoying the warm, slow payoff as the island comes back to life.

WISHLIST & FOLLOW

Wishlist Restore Your Island to follow development, see new screenshots and GIFs of restoration in action, and get notified at launch.
